method.sampling: Convenience sample from publicly exposed English US storefront reviews; targeted problem searches followed by positive and official counterchecks.
method.observation_unit: One distinct review; attached reply belongs to that review; multiple issues do not increase count.
search_examples: Trivia Crack The Floor App Store reviews ads bugs 2025
Quiz Planet QuizDuel app store reviews 2025
QuizDuel support FAQ classic match timer VIP premium
workflow: Open selected storefront review pages and inspect visible date/text/replies.
Retain positive and mixed accounts as counterexamples.
Cross-check product mechanics against official descriptions and help.
Separate reported experiences from confirmed documentation and researcher requirements.
limitations: No representative sampling or denominator; issue counts must not become market prevalence.
English search and storefront selection bias; ad/bug terms intentionally emphasize friction.
Storefront locale does not establish reviewer location, device, client version or played mode.
Current Trivia Crack The Floor branding does not make older/general reviews The Floor-mode reviews.
No stable individual review deep links exposed; use source URL plus date and locator.
No authenticated play, device reproduction, browser interaction, private data, proprietary code or bulk scraping.
Sporcle help and blog searches returned robots-blocking; no circumvention attempted.
Search for AppleVis criticism did not produce a reliable inspectable specific review page; it was excluded.
No professional critic article was counted; criticism here is direct public customer criticism.
Visible relative reply dates and help update ages remain unresolved when year/date absent.
Documentation can lag rollout or differ by mode/region; public replies are developer statements, not independent verification.
Source pages are mutable; individual selected observations may no longer be featured later.
method.quotation_note: Only short review titles and minimal date/product metadata are retained verbatim; no review-body passages are quoted. Review titles occur once, in JSON, to locate each observation.

recommended_priority_order: Compact play loop and intentional social actions
Question provenance, freshness and report feedback
Optional features and explicit purchase terms
deliverable_note: Research only; no claims about FACT//DUEL implementation or observed code.

source_budget_qa.scope: Conservative combined audit of Markdown and JSON, grouping observations by canonical source page rather than treating each review as a separate source.
source_budget_qa.duplicate_title_correction: Removed Markdown review titles; retained each once as a JSON locator. Four Quiz Planet titles previously occurred twice, totaling 32 words. Their retained combined title count is 16.
notes: Original FACT//DUEL requirements, severity reasoning and methodological caveats are researcher-authored, not additional source paraphrases.
Cross-artifact metadata is retained for inspectability; review-body summaries were tightened and repeated topical locators shortened.
No additional browsing or Site modifications during QA.
source_budget_qa.tally_method: Manual attribution of source-derived spans; counts include Markdown review metadata/observations, JSON product/date/locator/paraphrase/reply fields, ledger title/support descriptions and substantive source-specific facts elsewhere. Original recommendations, inferred severities, methodological caveats and bibliographic URLs excluded. Counts use words, not model tokens; allow remaining margin for minor attribution/tokenization differences.
source_budget_qa.other_sources: Each of the eleven official/help/commercial-report pages contributes fewer than 100 substantive source-derived words across both files; none uses a larger source limit.
source_budget_qa.verbatim_scope: Review titles are counted once, in JSON; no review-body quotations. Product names, bibliographic page titles and dates remain factual citation metadata.
